assets.notes: RIG's body sprite, loaded at runtime by src/render/player.js on a billboard plane (entry 16 authorizes this; entry 17 confirms FAR/~15x30px stays the target size, not a bigger character). Deliberately BODY-ONLY, no weapon drawn: a separate 3D gun mesh still supplies the 8-way-aim weapon visual, composited on top, so a baked-in gun shape would double up. Two earlier codex passes are kept out of the manifest as rejected iterations (see reports/tasks/T-040/build.md): one drew an extended rifle arm (conflicts with the rotating gun mesh), one had a wider running stance whose feet reached ~0.61x the figure's height in width (this version narrows that to ~0.51x). The drawn content's own width:height (bounding-box, not canvas) is still wider than the frozen 0.7x1.7 collision box's own 0.41 ratio - a render-only overrun on the limbs, same documented-not-narrowed precedent as this file's own gun-sweep and CONFIG.hound's 2.4x visual/hitbox split; the collision box itself is untouched. Falls back to a procedural CanvasTexture (src/pure/rig.js's HELMET/TORSO/LEG_FRONT/LEG_BACK shapes) if the image fails to load - the sim never branches on which one rendered.
